response.rationale: Both answers are valid and the cue broadly matches the intended sense. Indonesian gugup is an ordinary term for nervousness; Malaysian gementar is valid for apprehension, with an additional physical-trembling nuance. The different-common-word relation is defensible as a variety preference, though not exclusive. No false-friend contrast is asserted or required.
